name: akoya_request-grantee-deliverables
_comment: Grantee Deliverables Portal field wave (S268). Extends akoya_request because the portal collects exactly ONE deliverable package per grant/request cycle (one AI-formatted abstract the grantee edits/approves + one graphical image + a caption); see docs/GRANTEE_PORTAL_SPEC.md (DESIGN RESOLVED). Lives in its own wave so `apply-dataverse-schema --wave=2-grantee-deliverables` creates ONLY these fields and does NOT re-attempt drifted relationships from the full wave2 (same isolation reason as wave2-triagestatus / wave2-fieldprimer). schema-apply is CREATION-ONLY (lib/dataverse/schema-apply.js header + ensureAttribute) — it will NOT reconcile a divergent pre-existing field; run scripts/preflight-grantee-deliverables-fields.mjs FIRST. Picklist values mirror shared/config/granteeDeliverableStatus.js (the app-side source of truth); this JSON is the Dataverse source of truth and the two MUST stay in sync. MUST carry NO Power Automate trigger; verify post-deploy that writes limited to these new fields fire no AkoyaGO/PA flow. Publisher prefix wmkf. NOTE on naming: the AI-formatted + grantee-approved abstracts join the existing wmkf_abstract (applicant-drafted SOURCE, NOT created here) abstract family; schemaNames use repo PascalCase convention (no mid-name underscore), so logical names are wmkf_abstractformatted / wmkf_abstractapproved. The image-publication waiver is a client-side submit gate (checkbox enables submit), NOT a stored field — a submitted package IS the consent record — so NO consent fields exist in this wave.

attributes.description: AI-generated, style-guide-conforming abstract drafted from the applicant-authored wmkf_abstract. This is what the grantee is shown to edit/approve. NOT overwritten by the grantee edit (provenance: what we generated). Text by design; no binary.
The grantee-edited/approved abstract captured through the portal text editor. Stored separately from wmkf_AbstractFormatted so the original AI draft is preserved.
SharePoint URL/path/item reference for the grantee-submitted graphical image. The binary lives in SharePoint; only the reference is stored in Dataverse.
Free-text caption supplied by the grantee for the graphical image.
Lifecycle for the grantee deliverables package. Null/unset = not started. Mirrors shared/config/granteeDeliverableStatus.js; additively extensible without a migration.
